title: Coherent State
intro: A harmonic well (the rings are equipotentials) pulls the packet back and forth with period T = 2π/ω. Released from rest, a Gaussian generally breathes as it swings: its width oscillates between σ and 1/(2ωσ) twice per period. Exactly one width, σ₀ = 1/√(2ω), keeps its shape at all times: the coherent state, the quantum state that moves most like a classical particle. The detector clicks at t = 9T/8, as the packet passes the target.
